name: safe-trade-rule-builder
description: Local safe-trading plugin (no cloud deployment or external AI API). In-house: market-hours-guard checks trading-hours changes; margin-rule-check verifies collateral guidance against source-backed rules. Investors: computes forced-liquidation deadlines and required deposits, builds validated rule drafts, and registers persistent local price alerts with a running Windows notification worker. Quotes use the optional Yahoo/yfinance provider; no live orders.

interface.shortDescription: 거래시간·신용 규칙 점검, 반대매매 계산, 로컬 가격 감시·Windows 알림.
interface.longDescription: Three skills in one plugin, all deterministic and local. market-hours-guard (in-house developers/QA): compares time values in brokerage code and config with an approved session calendar including exchange special days, flags stale, DST-unsafe, or ambiguous values, generates boundary-time tests for pytest or JUnit 5 (Java/Kotlin), previews the impact of a calendar change, and exports SARIF for GitHub code scanning. margin-rule-check (in-house counseling quality/QA/developers): finds wrong collateral-ratio and forced-liquidation statements in scripts, notices, configs, and Word (.docx) documents, and generates rule-conformance tests (pytest or JUnit 5) for calculation code, with SARIF output. safe-trade-rule-builder (investors): checks credit-trading collateral ratios against KakaoPay Securities' published rules with sources, and converts trade requests (structured by Codex as rule JSON) into explainable drafts with session and time-window checks, policy guardrails, and manual confirmation. No live orders.
defaultPrompt: SOR 적용 시간이 20:00까지 늘어난 변경과 수능일 시간 변경이 이 저장소에 빠짐없이 반영됐는지 점검해줘.
상담 스크립트와 앱 설정에 담보비율·반대매매 안내가 규칙과 다르게 적힌 곳이 있는지 찾아줘.
